$comment: Golden vectors for new game creation (docs/formulas/new-game.md).
Every case is read out of fixtures/incoming/turn0/, a real three-player
game exactly as GenerateWorld left it, before anybody took a turn.

planet_count.source: GenerateWorld; cPlanMax = dGal*dGal/5000, +25% per density step, +25% again when packed
planet_count.$comment: Checked against GAME.cPlanMax in every .xy fixture; the file column names the one it came from.

coordinate_band.source: GenerateWorld; x and y are each 1000 + 10 + Random(dGal - 19)
coordinate_band.$comment: low is always 1010; high is 1010 + dGal - 20.

planet_shape.source: GenerateWorld's per-planet environment and mineral loop
$comment: Gravity and temperature are the sum of two draws and radiation is one,
so the first two reach their extremes about half as often. Measured over
the 600 unowned planets the fixtures describe, which carries about 2% of
Planet 0 of this game reads concentrations 86/8/67 and every homeworld
86/30/67: the stock is copied from planet 0 with a floor of 30.
The environments are the exact midpoints of their owners' habitable bands.
Planet 0's surface stock is zeroed once generation finds the planet
unowned, so it is not in the file. It is determined by the homeworlds:
only [337, 337, 306] with 25 and 50 points produces both 399/399/432 and
462/462/556 under the quarter-shares rule. 50 is 72 capped.
